_comment: Short-form model notes for the remote picker's info box (shown under the model list on hover/highlight). Keyed by roster alias; a '-thinking' variant falls back to its base alias. Long form: README 'NVIDIA model field notes'.
nvidia-nemotron-ultra: Nemotron 3 Ultra — capable on clearly-instructed work, relatively fast, 1M context. Thinks for long stretches; thinking blocks stream readably, and a queued prompt nudges the run mid-thought. Caveat: can act rash — may present untested work as done and struggles with complex, loosely-scoped problems; scope asks tightly and check its "done". Super takes these shortcuts even more.
nvidia-nemotron3: Nemotron 3 Super — extremely fast, but takes the path of least resistance and declares goals done early. Good for quick, well-scoped asks; check its "done".
nvidia-glm53-full: GLM 5.3 — very smart, finds problems and solutions on its own; slow, ideal unattended overnight. 1M context. Don't /resume a long session cold: send "hello" first, then /resume-interrupted. ~1 min NVIDIA-side wait before the first token.
nvidia-glm53: GLM 5.3 Flash — much faster than GLM 5.3, still surprisingly smart at investigating context. Balanced thinking and output; the everyday reasoning driver.
nvidia-laguna: Laguna XS 2.1 (Poolside) — coding specialist with capable tool use. 33B params / 3B active / 256K context (poolside.ai + NVIDIA NIM docs, 2026-10-15). Slow first prompt, then speeds up; slower than Nemotron Ultra. A stray think-tag may show in output — likely a reasoning tail: Laguna is probably a thinking model whose thinking blocks the harness does not recognize.
nvidia-deepseek-v4: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — works, but SLOW: minutes per request (a 4-file review took about 10 min, 2026-10-21) and earlier probes timed out at 90-180 s, so it was hidden until then. Thorough, well-grounded analysis once it answers. Best as an offload dispatch with a long timeout; too slow per turn for a full interactive session. NVIDIA may still time it out under load.
nvidia-kimi-k3: Kimi K3 — retired by NVIDIA on 2026-10-15 (410 Gone). Never answered in a full Claude Code session; other providers listing it want paid credits.
nvidia-step5-preview: StepFun Step 5 Preview — ran an 18-hour session, 589 turns, zero API errors, shipping three releases; median turn 23 s. One of the best models on NVIDIA (user, 2026-10-24). 1M context.
